name: zzS07_skin_parity_all

skins.costume_parity: n/a -- this skin IS the canonical body, there is no costume over it

tests.name: every active skin goes on, and every one but the canon body (Relay OG) is dressed
no skin mismatches the pose it was handed, on any field

detail.note: the authority reads n/a, not 0. It has no costume to be compared against, and a zero there would be a claim that was never tested.

tests.name: every skin wears the pose AND performs the act
the rig is moving, so parity is not agreement between two frozen figures

detail.note: zero mismatches is satisfied just as well by a skin copying a dead Dog, so the parity clauses above mean nothing without this one.

tests.name: and none of them is failing, and none of them went unmeasured

detail.note: two lists, not one. FAILING is a statement about the product; UNMEASURED is a statement about this proof. Either turns the gate red, and merging them once planted a false blocker on the default mascot.

tests.name: every active skin was actually tested, none silently dropped

detail.note: Relay OG was absent from this list until 2026-09-27, so every clause reported a clean result for a lineup that did not include the default mascot. Coverage is asserted here so that cannot recur quietly.
